scientific_integrity: The continuous claim is proved analytically; separate exact-arithmetic tests are corroborative only. Historical priority remains provisional, especially for unindexed inversion-pedal literature.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to centered unit-tangential right rhombic prisms. It is not a theorem about arbitrary parallelotopes or noncentral pedal maps, and makes no assertion about later iterates.
title: A unique skew volume optimum for the second pedal of tangential rhombic prisms
